items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Jesse Hooker, I hung around... I used to follow him around... So it gave me ideas... she showed me the value of the notes and things. Took me out to his home... sit up around 2 or 3 o'clock in the morning.

ctx.x: Now, one of the big names on clarinet at that time was Johnny Dodds. How did you rate his playing?
Oh, no... Jesse Hooker was the one I....
Jesse Hooker. You had heard him.
